preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:20] for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[:20] for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B must consist of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters.
